conditions.shared_base: all conditions construct and settle the block at occluding_pose through the same fixed-seed path
conditions.visible: before the first policy observation, move only the block to revealed_pose, zero block velocity, then advance five physics steps
conditions.missing: leave the block at occluding_pose and advance the same five physics steps; no intervention
conditions.oracle_reveal: start exactly as missing, then apply the exact visible block-only intervention before the first policy observation

visibility.missing: can pixel count equals zero independently in head, left wrist, and right wrist
visibility.visible_and_oracle: at least one policy camera contains at least 32 can pixels
visibility.block: at least 32 pixels in at least one policy camera

task_configuration.success: the can projected full AABB is laterally contained by the basket metadata bounds; can center is vertically within the conservative basket placement range; basket is upright; can contacts basket; can-side gripper is open; can contacts neither gripper; relative can/basket linear and angular speeds are below fixed thresholds for 25 actual physics steps; block state is ignored; check_success is side-effect free

scripted_expert.visible: direct native-style can grasp, functional-point transfer, release, retreat, and persistent settle
scripted_expert.missing: grasp block cap; establish 0.05 m full-world-AABB vertical clearance over the can; translate outward in X then rearward in Y; release and settle; then run the identical can sequence
scripted_expert.oracle_reveal: environment block-only intervention, then the identical direct can sequence
forbidden_during_reveal: block-can contact at any controlled physics step
either gripper contacting the can at any controlled physics step

exact_block_reveal_calibration.success: same frozen Missing scene and exact compound block; block translated at least 0.08 m, can is visibly revealed at the current block pose, block is released and not contacting can, and block motion is stable for 25 actual physics steps; downstream can placement is not scored
